test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

The children sat by the **__hearth__** to keep away the cold.
solution: The correct answer is **"fireside."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Hearth"** means the place where you have an open fire in the house or the area in front of it. (घर में चूल्‍हा जलाने की जगह या चूल्‍हे के सामने की जगह) • **Example**:* They were reluctant to leave **hearth**__ and home.* • **"Fireside"** is a synonym of **hearth**. • **"Fireside"** refers to the area in front of a fireplace where a fire is burned. (कमरे में अग्निस्‍थल के आस-पास का स्‍थान) __ • **Example**: *After a long day at work, I like to relax by the **fireside**__ with a good book.* • It is used to indicate a warm and cozy atmosphere. • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1) tandoor**: a cylindrical clay or metal oven used in cooking and baking in some parts of Asia. (मध्य-पूर्व एवं दक्षिण एशिया में लोकप्रिय मिट्टी का एक बड़ा चूल्हा, तंदूर) • **Option 3) oven**: a thermally insulated chamber used for heating, baking, or drying food. (बक्‍सनुमा अँगीठी, ओवन) • **Option 4) convent:** a religious community of women typically living under vows of poverty, chastity, and obedience. (विशेषतः ईसाई साध्वियों का आश्रम; कॉन्‍वेंट) 15e:Tb70, The correct answer is **"Foreign."**
